profiles.biography: Dr. John Bell is a music/general-effect adjudicator and conductor who directs the Wind Ensemble at McKendree University (Lebanon, IL) and is music and artistic director of the St. Louis Brass Band. He is Professor of Music Emeritus from Southern Illinois University Edwardsville, where he spent 30 years as Director of Bands and Professor of Conducting and Music Education. He served as Brass Caption Head for the Cavaliers and Blue Knights drum and bugle corps and has adjudicated for Drum Corps International, Bands of America, and the World Music Festival across the U.S., Canada, Japan, and Thailand, registered as a Master Judge with the Marching Roundtable Judges Academy. He is an elected member of the American Bandmasters Association, the American School Band Directors Association, and the North American Brass Band Association board, and holds doctoral and master's degrees from the University of Illinois and a bachelor's from LSU.

profiles.biography: Todd Fox is a percussion/music adjudicator who has judged drum corps and the percussion music caption since 1994 and serves as the Drum Corps International Central Division Judges Coordinator. He has served as chief judge at the DCI Kalamazoo event and has held percussion-related judging roles at DCI World Championships, including Ensemble Percussion and Music Analysis, and judges the Winds Music Analysis caption for Winter Guard International.

profiles.biography: Curtis Costanza is a general-effect/visual adjudicator and judge administrator based in Vancouver, Washington, where he is a middle school teacher. He has extensive judging experience with Drum Corps International, Winter Guard International, Bands of America, and the Winter Guard Association of Southern California, and serves as chief judge administrator for WGI and for the Northwest Association for Performing Arts. He judged the General Effect Visual captions at DCI World Championships, including the 2008-2010 seasons.
